critique.evidence: The contrarian “Accuracy is the wrong question” headline, evaluation-ledger framing, cyan/red signal palette, and dense monospaced annotations create a coherent defense-console identity across viewports. However, the main experience still resolves into familiar KPI cards, standard charts, a confusion matrix, and a data table; no single visualization or interaction shown becomes a signature demo moment. Mobile further reduces the composition to a long stack of conventional panels, while the clipped header rail weakens the intended command-center impression.
critique.fix: Create one unmistakable centerpiece that visually connects false-positive constraints, confusion-matrix outcomes, latency, and fraud value into an interactive operating-threshold story. Let users scrub the threshold and watch every metric and cost consequence update together; preserve that signature interaction on mobile with a compact sticky control.
